caption: The drawing depicts a metallic candlestick holder rendered in shades of brass and gold. The primary object is a vertical candlestick stand with a circular, flat base featuring an intricate, openwork pattern of concentric circles, radiating spokes, and ornamental shapes. Attached to the base is a curved handle. Rising from the center of the base is a straight, slender stem which supports a horizontal arm. The arm has two features: a candle socket with a round wax-catching dish and a candle snuffer attached at the opposite end, designed as a downward-facing, ornate piece. Above the bottom view, there is a detailed circular pattern of the base, showing symmetrical cut-outs, and to the right of this is a close-up side profile of the handle. The drawing background is plain, and the outline is clean, with subtle shading to suggest the reflective metallic surface. The artist’s name, "JANET RIZA," appears in small uppercase letters in the bottom right corner.
title: Taper Jack
